name: Fubo

fastest.text: Sign in at fubo.tv, open Settings → My Account → Subscription, expand your plan and select Cancel.

steps: Sign in at fubo.tv in a web browser and pick any profile.
Select the settings icon, then My Account.
Select Subscription, then select your plan to expand it.
Scroll down and select Cancel. If Fubo offers you a discount, your plan isn't cancelled yet: select CANCEL SUBSCRIPTION to finish.
note: Signed up through Roku? Cancel on the Roku website or your Roku device; Fubo's website can't cancel it.

faq.a: No. Fubo doesn't refund prepaid or partial months; your plan keeps working until the end of the billing cycle. Most plans have no cancellation fee, but a promotional offer with a commitment period can.

faq.q: What if I'm on a free trial?
faq.a: If you signed up on Fubo's website, cancelling a trial ends your access straight away. A trial started through Roku runs until it ends.
No, Fubo doesn't offer pauses. You can cancel and restart your subscription later.
After the July 2026 increase, Fubo Essential is {monthly:Essential} in the US and Elite is {monthly:Elite}.
